root_cause.text: The `e1000_tbi_should_accept()` function in the e1000 driver unconditionally dereferences the last byte of the RX buffer using the descriptor-reported length without validating if the length is zero or exceeds the actual RX buffer size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds checks to reject frames if `length` is zero (`!length`) or exceeds `adapter->rx_buffer_len` before performing the dereference `last_byte = *(data + length - 1)`.
